> OpenWeb powers communities across the Open Internet, turning real participation into direct audience relationships, actionable insights, and revenue. This file is the expanded, full-content companion to /llms.txt.

OpenWeb (founded 2015 as Spot.IM, rebranded 2020) provides community, moderation, audience engagement, advertising, and monetization technology for publishers and brands. Headquarters: 38 Greene St, New York, NY. More: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenWeb

## Company

### OpenWeb — The Community Engine of the Open Internet

URL: https://www.openweb.com/

OpenWeb powers communities across the Open Internet, turning real participation into direct audience relationships, actionable insights, and revenue.

OpenWeb is the community engine that turns real participation into direct audience relationships, transparent insights, and measurable revenue performance.

#### Trusted by Leaders in Media

Minutes spent on platform

Turn audience participation into long-term strategic business value.

Participation drives repeat behavior, not just content consumption.

- Content Articles and editorial content from trusted publishers
- Participation Authenticated users interact, react, comment & share
- Loyalty Users return more frequently and spend more time on site
- Community Like-minded groups form directly on publisher sites
- Revenue Returning users and high-attention inventory drive incremental revenue

Turn engagement into community, trust, and revenue, on your terms.

### Advertisers overview

URL: https://www.openweb.com/advertisers/

Reach real people in moments that matter with OpenWeb Community Exchange — connect your brand to high-attention publisher communities across the open internet.

OpenWeb’s Community Exchange connects you to communities across premium publishers, turning behavior into clear signals of intent, and enabling campaigns in high-attention environments across the Open Internet.

#### Trusted by Leaders in Media

#### Traditional advertising reaches users as they scroll. Community Exchange helps reach them as they engage.

#### Where Attention Becomes Participation

OpenWeb’s community engine powers the environments where audiences actively engage, comment, react, and contribute in real time.

- Participation People actively participate across trusted publisher environments
- Signals Signals captured from comments, reactions, and topic engagement
- Segments Audience segments built from expressed signals, not inferred behaviors
- Activation Activated across display, video, native, and in-conversation formats

#### User Safety is Brand Safety.

OpenWeb’s best-in-class moderation tech is an end-to-end system trusted by the world’s top publishers. That’s brand safety at scale.

- Filters unsafe, toxic, and low-quality content at scale.
- Supports brand-safe environments across publisher communities.
- Reduces spam, bots, and fraudulent engagement.
- Helps build audience signals from trusted, moderated conversations.

#### Real People. Real Results.

OpenWeb’s Community Exchange connects your brand to high-attention environments, turning participation into measurable outcomes across the Open Internet.

##### Media Exchange

Activate campaigns across premium publishers through a unified activation layer, bringing together high-attention environments and formats like video, social, rich media, native, and display to drive scalable, high-quality engagement.

##### Community Media

Activate your brand within live community environments, where conversations, reactions, and participation signal real attention and intent. With exclusive placements across forums, in-conversation, and contextual units, you reach audiences in the moments where engagement is highest.

Reach real audiences in trusted, opt-in environments where curated content and high attention drive deeper engagement beyond the feed.

##### Sponsored Comments

Scale campaigns across premium publishers with OpenWeb Media Exchange — rich media, social extensions, native display, and outstream video built for attention.

OpenWeb Media Exchange brings together inventory across premium publishers on the Open Internet into a unified activation layer, allowing you to scale campaigns without sacrificing quality.

Give your readers a reason to stick around, register, and keep coming back.

Share your assets. We transform them into the right ad formats based on the outcomes you want to achieve.

Use community-powered audiences across premium inventory on the Open Internet.

Rich Media brings motion, interactivity, and flexibility to your campaigns, giving audiences a reason to actively engage with your brand and creating experiences that are more memorable and drive higher engagement.

##### Social Extensions

Take your existing creative assets, including video, carousel, and shoppable units, beyond the walled gardens and into premium publisher environments. Scale what already works, reach new audiences, and get more out of the assets you already have.

##### Native & Display

Native and component-based formats dynamically render to match the host environment, delivering superior CTRs. Display formats available across a wide range of sizes, accessible programmatically at scale.

##### Outstream Video

A video format that delivers a natural viewing experience across premium publisher environments, achieving exceptional VTR performance.
